description:
Best Value Electric Bicycles for Adults in Canada

LEO 26" Adult Electric Bike: City Commuter's Choice with Pedal Assist & 3.0" Fat Tires

How to Assemble the LEO Electric Bike https://youtu.be/aLBibMFlIQw

Excellent riding experience: This electric bike is equipped with 26 inch tires. Lockable front fork suspension reduces vibration caused by bumpy road conditions and 7-speed transmission can easily overcomes rough road conditions. The dual disc brake and lighting system ensure your riding safety.

Large capacity battery and brushless motor: The bicycle is equipped with a 48V, 11.6Ah battery, you can use the second gear pedal to assist in driving up to 80-86 km (49.7-53.4 miles). 500W (Peak 1000W) rear drive, top speed of 32 kilometers per hour (20 miles per hour), powerful brushless motor provides low interference, low noise, quiet and smooth riding experience.

Durable and sturdy: Electric bicycles use a lower frame to make getting on and off more convenient, and effectively reduce riding resistance, providing a high-speed and smooth riding experience. The parallel bars design increases the strength of the body to ensure sufficient durability and safety.

Multiple speed modes: This electric bicycle has 5 speed modes, cruise control and push assist functions, which perfectly meet the traffic demand of going to work or going out. Choose the appropriate riding speed according to your needs, and easily provide more convenience for your work and life.

Reliable after-sales service: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. Assembly can be quickly completed after unboxing. Different accessories for bicycles come with a one-year or 180 day warranty. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact us and we are always ready to assist you.
